proposals.status: author proposal; exact chemical endpoint issuing identity required
proposals.description: Synthetic NCBI-derived SYK-6 ligAB in pET15b/E. coli BL21; alpha initially N-His-tagged, beta untagged; anaerobic purification and thrombin cleavage (P8–P16). 2,3,4-trihydroxybenzoic acid gave95% lower PCA O2-consumption rate with500micromolarPCA/1mM inhibitor,3–7nMLigAB,50mMTrispH7.5,25C,air saturation(P27,Table2b). This assay does not establish gallate-flux inhibition or a competitive Ki.

proposals.status: author proposal; exact chemical endpoint and pretreatment context required
proposals.description: Synthetic NCBI-derived SYK-6 ligAB in pET15b/E. coli BL21; alpha initially N-His-tagged, beta untagged; anaerobic purification and thrombin cleavage (P8–P16). After1mMEDTA2h left50%activity,2mMCu2+1h lowered residualPCAactivity to8%untreated. P23/P34;metal protocol anaerobic4C;250micromolarPCA. Co2+/Mn2+did not cause the additional loss. This is not an untreated-enzyme Cu effect or a measured gallate-flux effect.

The effect is partial rescue of treated material,not general activation ofnativeLigAB or gallateflux.
